stations.title: Ines
stations.say: What if a card is declined?
stations.note: A queue at the Saturday stall.

stations.title: Card machine
stations.text: Declines a card, or says it is busy.

captions: Await works. At the stall, Ines asks what happens when the card machine says no.
Today one declined card stops the laptop with red text, and the whole queue waits.
You catch failures, try a busy machine again, and turn the screen off either way.
The card for WC-4002 is declined, the laptop says so in one line, and the queue moves on.
A failed wait is now something your code handles, instead of a crash.
